clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Velora Nitely sends Horde warriors to gather Dragonmaw Shinbones for Brutal Legguards. The hunt leads to the southern Wetlands, where the hostile orcs carry bones thick enough to brace the armor.

Velora Nitely, a Forsaken armorer in the Undercity, needs a strong brace for Brutal Legguards. She sends Horde warriors to the Wetlands for thick, resilient bone from the Dragonmaw orcs. Their dense frames can bear the heavy blows a seasoned warrior faces.

Velora needs more than any bone taken from the Dragonmaw. Each one must withstand a hand test; a bone that snaps is too brittle for the forge. Warriors scour the renegade camps along the Wetlands' crags, breaking weak specimens until eight sturdy shinbones remain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To make the brutal leg guards, I need a brace of sturdy shinbones. The Dragonmaw orcs of the Wetlands have nice, thick shinbones. I'll need theirs.
But they must be sturdy. Be sure to test the shinbones as you collect them. If you can break them with your bare hands, then they won't be sturdy enough to work with.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm waiting for those shinbones, friend. They'll make a nice frame for your leg guards.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! These all look strong. I think they'll do quite nicely. How did those orcs mind you taking their shins, friend? Complain much?
That was another joke. You're not laughing.
I'm not very funny these days, am I...
